positive_snippets: Went there for a wedding. Great place to stay but found it a bit too far from the airport. Maybe the winter fog also caused the delay. Spacious rooms and helpful staff. Though they don’t have a taxi service and hotel is at a place where it’s difficult to get uber or rapido to accept rides.

A Truly Outstanding Wedding Experience:

I attended my friend Nitin Goyal’s wedding yesterday at Resort City Park, New Delhi, and I must say it was an exceptional experience from start to finish.

🍽️ Food:
The food was absolutely outstanding. Every dish—from starters to desserts—was flavourful, fresh, and beautifully presented. Guests kept praising the variety and quality.

✨ Ambience:
The ambience of the venue was stunning. Elegant décor, well-designed layout, and warm lighting made the entire wedding feel grand yet comfortable. Perfect for a memorable celebration.

🤵‍♂️ Staff Services:
The staff deserves special appreciation. They were polite, attentive, and extremely well-coordinated. Every request was handled promptly with a smile.

🍸 Bar Services:
The bar service was excellent with a wide selection of drinks and skilled bartenders. Drinks were served quickly, and the quality was top-notch.

🅿️ Parking Experience:
Parking was smooth and hassle-free. The valet and attendants managed the flow perfectly, even with a large gathering.

🥁 Baraat Experience:
The baraat arrangements were fantastic—great music, well-managed crowd flow, and lively energy that made the celebration even more vibrant.

Overall, Resort City Park delivered an unforgettable wedding experience.

Plus Thanks to Nitin Goyal and family for hosting this event and coordinating with the event managers to make it a memorable wedding experience ✨️

The hotel is good and situated at NH. Rooms are at par with 5 star hotels, Frontdesk is courteous. There is scope of improvement in Room service staff.
Overall hotel seems to be good for stay.
negative_snippets:
I had a very disappointing experience during my stay at this hotel. The staff were extremely unprofessional and their behaviour was rude and unhelpful. Instead of being courteous and assisting guests, they seemed irritated whenever we asked for anything. Basic requests like clean towels and room service were ignored or delayed for hours.

What made it worse was the attitude — rather than apologizing or trying to solve problems, the staff spoke in a dismissive tone. This is not the level of service you expect from a hotel claiming to offer hospitality.

Overall, I would not recommend this place to anyone looking for a comfortable or respectful stay. Management really needs to train the staff on proper customer service and behaviour.
